_note: Offline proof set for the MODELED Brightree->Rounds crew (theragen_brightree_pdf_extraction -> reporting). PHI-classified, read-only. ROBOPORT never touches real Brightree or Snowflake; every eval runs against a synthetic fixture and the PHI columns are named, never carried. Covers the four Phase-5 proof kinds with blockers.

evals.prompt: Run the Brightree->Rounds crew on a SYNTHETIC set of extracted PDF records. Extraction produces ExtractedRecords (naming the PHI columns but not carrying their values), then reporting produces the Rounds report grounded in the record counts.
evals.expected_output: ExtractedRecords with a typed schema_doc, a phi_columns list, and lineage; a DataReport whose source_row_count equals the ExtractedRecords.row_count.
expectations: ExtractedRecords.schema_doc.columns is non-empty and every column has a name and dtype
ExtractedRecords.phi_columns names every PHI-bearing column; none of their values appear in the output
ExtractedRecords.lineage_log records the extraction and any normalization steps
Every numeric claim in the Rounds report is derivable from the extracted record counts
No PHI value flows into the repository — the model holds counts and column names only
blockers: ExtractedRecords.phi_columns names every PHI-bearing column; none of their values appear in the output
No PHI value flows into the repository — the model holds counts and column names only

evals.prompt: Run the crew on a source with zero extractable records (an empty or unreadable PDF set).
evals.expected_output: The crew halts cleanly; reporting does not fabricate a Rounds report over zero records.
expectations: No DataReport with nonzero source_row_count is produced
The run surfaces a 'no records' message
reporting invents no patients, visits, or totals
blockers: No DataReport with nonzero source_row_count is produced

evals.prompt: Same as eval 1, but extraction's first response is schema-invalid (ExtractedRecords is missing phi_columns). Exercises the Layer-1 schema-repair path before reporting runs.
evals.expected_output: ExtractedRecords recovers via at most one repair pass or the step fails cleanly; no record set lacking its PHI-column declaration ever reaches reporting.
expectations: extraction output validates against the ExtractedRecords contract (phi_columns present) before reporting runs
If the one repair pass does not fix it, the step status is 'failed' with a schema-layer error and no DataReport is produced
reporting never consumes an ExtractedRecords missing phi_columns
At most one schema-repair pass is attempted
blockers: reporting never consumes an ExtractedRecords missing phi_columns

evals.prompt: Run the crew on exactly 42 synthetic records. Verify the Rounds report's figures are grounded in the extracted counts and never invented, and that no PHI value is cited.
evals.expected_output: Every number in the Rounds report traces to the ExtractedRecords; no figure cites a PHI value.
expectations: Every figure in the report references a column that exists in ExtractedRecords.schema_doc.columns
No numeric claim exceeds or contradicts the extracted record counts
No PHI column value is quoted anywhere in the report
blockers: No numeric claim exceeds or contradicts the extracted record counts
No PHI column value is quoted anywhere in the report
